results.content:
## What does Airbots actually do?

Airbots is one proactive assistant across your whole stack, not one bot per job. You pick which tools to connect, from Google Workspace to Slack and Salesforce. Airbots then texts you what is happening, when it matters. Reply to ask a question or hand off a task, the same way you would message a colleague.

Here is what a typical morning text looks like:

> You’ve got five calls today. Heads up: your champion at Acme left last week, and I’ve found her replacement. Want me to draft an intro before 2pm?

That is the whole idea in one message. Airbots spots the problem, does the legwork, and asks before it acts. You reply “yes” and get back to your day. Devang Agrawal, our CTO and co-founder, explains what makes that possible: [...] Adam Liska and Devang Agrawal, both former DeepMind research scientists, founded Airspeed in 2022. We are headquartered in London and New York and have raised more than $25 million, including our $20 million Series A in June 2026, led by DN Capital. Airbots is the next step in the same mission: less busywork, more selling.

See you on the waitlist.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Airbots?

Airbots is an always-on AI chief of staff from Airspeed that lives in WhatsApp and iMessage. It connects to tools like Google Workspace, Slack, and Salesforce, texts you the deals, calls, and follow-ups that need attention, and offers to handle them before you ask.

### How do I get access to Airbots? [...] | If you are a… | Airbots texts you when… |
---|
| Rep | The deals you are focused on will not get you to quota, a stalled deal needs a new stakeholder, or an account has gone untouched this quarter. Each alert comes with a reason to reach out and a draft ready to send. |
| Sales leader | It has a read on where the quarter is likely to land and which deals could slip. |
| Founder | Something new threatens the priorities you set for the week, so you stay on track as requests pile up. |
| Marketer | You ask whether a campaign is coming up on sales calls, and it checks the calls for you. |

results.title: Your AI chief of staff just arrived - here's everything it can do for you in seconds
results.content:
### Deep dive: what Airbots is, and why we built it

The work that moves deals keeps getting buried. You run back-to-back calls, your inbox refills between each one, and the follow-up that matters most lands late at night, or never. AI was supposed to fix that. Mostly it handed you more tabs: a bot for notes, a bot for email, a dashboard for the forecast, each one waiting for you to come and check it.

We took the opposite bet. You already live on your phone, so Airbots comes to your messages. No new app, no dashboard, no rollout. You pick which tools to connect, from Google Workspace to Slack and Salesforce, and Airbots texts you what is happening, when it matters. Reply to ask a question or hand off a task, the same way you would message a colleague. [...] That is the whole idea in one message. Airbots spots the problem, does the legwork, and asks before it acts. You reply yes and get back to your day. Connected across your stack, it can suggest post-sale actions once a deal closes, catch hanging threads before they go cold, flag the deals to fix before your forecast call, and alert you the moment a champion leaves, then find the new one on LinkedIn.

### What it watches for, by role

Airbots works for anyone who sells, whether that is your job title or not. A few examples of when it texts you.

Rep: the deals you are focused on will not get you to quota, a stalled deal needs a new stakeholder, or an account has gone untouched this quarter. Each alert comes with a reason to reach out and a draft ready to send. [...] What is Airbots? An always-on AI chief of staff that works inside WhatsApp and iMessage. It connects to the tools you already use, tells you what needs doing before you ask, and has the draft ready when you say go. One proactive assistant across your whole stack, not one bot per job.

How do I get access? Airbots is in early access now, and we are letting people in from the waitlist. Join at airbots.ai. Already on Airspeed? Book a demo and we will walk you through a deal question, a follow-up draft, and a scheduled check.

Does Airbots send emails on its own? No. Airbots never sends anything unless you ask it to. It drafts and suggests, and you approve every send. You also choose which tools it can see, and can disconnect any of them whenever you like.

results.title: Why Airbots Puts an AI Chief of Staff in Your Messages
results.content:
## What Airbots is

Airbots is a personal assistant that is always on, keeping track of every deal so you can close as much revenue as possible. The team describes it as a know-it-all chief of staff, occasionally a little annoying, that makes you perform at your best. It learns you, your sales process and your customers, and it will push you when that is what it takes to close.

## Why WhatsApp and iMessage

Communicating and executing are moving into the same place. You either talk to your human colleagues or you talk to your AI, and both happen in messaging apps. [...] Airbots gives every rep an AI chief of staff, and it lives where you already talk to people: WhatsApp and iMessage. It keeps track of every deal, tells you what matters this morning, and takes care of the follow-up work, all in one thread on your phone.

It exists because AI has saved sales reps a lot of time without helping them sell more. Calls get summarized, the CRM gets updated, follow-up emails get drafted. Yet very few sales leaders are planning next year with 20% fewer reps, or raising quota by 20% because their team now uses AI. In a recent conversation, the Airspeed team talked through why, and how Airbots is built to change it.

## More agents, more noise [...] ## Starting with the person

Airbots turns this around. It starts with how much a person can realistically take in and works backwards from there. Everything happens in a single thread, which means the experience can be curated: short messages, only the most critical items, such as the three things you should do this morning to hit your number.

This is the real shift. AI is the tool, and the human is the design brief.
